verdict.rationale: Swell only documents CSV import/export for products and categories, not a comprehensive open-format export of all store data (orders, customers, custom models, etc.), and there's no documented full data-portability or account-closure export mechanism. Missing for 10: evidence of full-store data export (all models/entities) in open formats, a documented data portability/export-all endpoint, and any confirmation that a merchant can fully migrate away with all their data.
